seo.title: Leviathan Autonomy | Beringia Marine
seo.description: Distributed passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) and sensor fusion for port, harbor, and naval-base security. Beringia Marine is Leviathan Autonomy's US market representative, technical advisor, and US Prime contractor / integration partner for US government programs.

overview.title: Leviathan Autonomy
overview.description: Leviathan Autonomy is a pre-seed defense-technology company building a distributed passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) and sensor-fusion platform — the Insight Engine — for port, harbor, and naval-base security. A Delaware corporation with an operating subsidiary in Bergamo, Italy, Leviathan has signed Beringia Marine as its primary US market representative, strategic advisor, and US Prime contractor and integration partner for US government programs.

points.title: Insight Engine — Distributed PAM & Sensor Fusion
points.description: A distributed passive acoustic monitoring and sensor-fusion platform that detects, classifies, and tracks underwater and surface activity across a port, harbor, or naval base.
features: Distributed passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) sensor network
Multi-sensor fusion across acoustic and complementary sensors
Purpose-built for port, harbor, and naval-base security
Software platform with licensable analytics and data services

points.title: PAM Sensor Hardware
points.description: Underwater passive-acoustic sensors deployed as a distributed array for persistent, wide-area monitoring of harbor and littoral environments.
features: Built for naval-base and critical-infrastructure protection

points.title: System Integration & Support
points.description: Integration of the PAM array and software platform into operational maritime-security environments, with training, support, and maintenance.

useCases.title: Target Markets
useCases.description: Leviathan's platform is built for US and allied government maritime-security programs, brought to the US market by Beringia Marine.

cases.title: US Navy & Naval-Base Security
cases.description: Persistent passive acoustic monitoring for naval-base force protection and harbor security.

cases.title: US Coast Guard
cases.description: Maritime domain awareness and port-security monitoring for Coast Guard missions.

cases.title: Port & Harbor Authorities
cases.description: Distributed monitoring for commercial and strategically significant ports and harbors.

cases.title: Allied Government Programs
cases.description: Maritime-security programs with US-allied defense partners.

valueProposition.title: Beringia's Role in the Partnership
valueProposition.description: Under a consulting agreement signed in 2026, Beringia Marine serves as Leviathan Autonomy's primary US market representative and the US Prime contractor / integration partner for US government programs — a structure that enables ITAR-compliant access to US defense end-users and program offices.
highlights: US Prime contractor & integration partner for US government programs
Customer development with US defense end-users and program offices
Technical advisory: sensor evaluation, system architecture, integration planning
Identification of US technology partners, hardware suppliers, and research institutions
ITAR-compliant US program access via Beringia-held prime contracts
